observations: The actual TradingView Gold, Silver and Gold/Silver Ratio widgets rendered populated charts in GitHub Actions run 44662805307; their screenshots were visually inspected.
A separate cloud-browser visit to the exact candidate selected Gold/Silver Ratio and showed the native TVC:GOLDSILVER title, populated OHLC values and candles, with a then-observed close of 84.456.
The real widget's 3M range control was selected; the chart changed from daily to one-hour intervals and displayed populated three-month history.
The ratio guide, ratio-of-80 example, falling-ratio silver-strength explanation, and official TradingView source link were checked in the candidate.
Phone/tablet layout, choice ordering, accessibility and source selection were separately tested with provider mocks at 320, 390, 768 and 1363 pixels. No wallet or payment actions were used.
